home.who_title: Built To Deliver A Better Home Improvement Experience
home.who_text:
Ironclad Exteriors was built on a simple belief: a great homeowner experience shouldn’t end when the consultation is over. The in-home meeting is an important part of the process. We take the time to educate, answer questions, and help you make the right decision with confidence. But that’s only the beginning.

Where we believe we stand apart is in everything that comes next. From proactive communication and dependable scheduling to expert installation and ongoing support, we’re committed to delivering an experience that lives up to the expectations we set from day one. Because at the end of the day, what you’ll remember most isn’t just the conversation, it's how we followed through.
home.virtual_title: A Consultation That Fits Your Schedule
home.virtual_text: Busy schedule? Meet with us virtually. We can review product options, project scope, pricing, and financing remotely, then coordinate measurements when it makes sense for you.
home.launch_text: We occasionally partner with local homeowners whose projects are a strong fit for showcasing our work. In exchange for allowing before-and-after photos, a yard sign, an honest review, and referral opportunities, qualifying homeowners may receive preferred project pricing.
home.final_text: Tell us what matters most—budget, design, efficiency, noise reduction, or phasing—and we’ll help you compare the right options without the pressure.

about.hero_title: A Better Experience, From First Conversation To Final Walkthrough
about.story_text:
Ironclad Exteriors was founded on a simple belief: homeowners deserve an experience that is just as exceptional after the consultation as it is during it. A great in-home consultation should be informative, honest, and pressure-free. It should leave you feeling confident in your decisions and excited about your project. But that’s only the first step.

We created Ironclad Exteriors because we saw an opportunity to raise the standard for everything that follows. From clear communication and dependable scheduling to skilled craftsmanship and attentive service, we’re committed to making every stage of your project reflect the same professionalism and care that earned your trust in the first place. We believe what homeowners remember most isn’t just the conversation, it’s how their home was treated, how smoothly the installation was completed, and how responsive we are long after the work is finished.

We also believe that how a company spends its resources says a lot about its priorities. Rather than pouring money into expensive advertising campaigns or tired sales gimmicks, we invest where it directly benefits our customers: premium products, experienced installers, continuous training, and dependable customer support. Our goal isn’t to win your business with flashy offers—it’s to earn it through honest guidance, exceptional value, and a commitment to doing things the right way.

That philosophy has shaped how we’ve grown from day one. Instead of relying on aggressive marketing, we’ve built Ironclad Exteriors through referrals, reputation, and the trust of homeowners who are proud to recommend us to the people they care about. We’re not focused on becoming the biggest exterior remodeling company. We’re focused on becoming the one homeowners think of first because they know they’ll be treated with honesty, respect, and professionalism from the first conversation to the final walkthrough.

windows.hero_title: Replacement Windows Built For Ohio Homes
windows.hero_text: Compare styles, glass packages, efficiency options, installation methods, and price points to find the right fit for your home—not just the most expensive window on the table.

doors.hero_title: Entry Doors Built Around Your Home
doors.hero_text: Fiberglass and steel entry door options combining security, energy efficiency, curb appeal, decorative glass, and a wide range of paint and stain choices.

siding.hero_title: Siding That Protects, Performs & Looks Right
siding.hero_text: Vinyl siding, James Hardie options, trim wrap, soffit and fascia—designed around curb appeal, weather protection, low maintenance, and long-term performance.

financing.hero_title: Flexible Financing For The Project You Want
financing.hero_text: Explore financing through Hearth with access to multiple lending options, flexible monthly payments, and a simple online process without changing the way we help you compare project options.
financing.disclaimer: Financing options, rates, terms, and approvals are provided by third-party lenders and are subject to lender requirements.

launch.hero_text: A neighborhood-based program for select projects where homeowners can receive preferred pricing in exchange for helping us showcase the finished transformation locally.
launch.requirements: Before-and-after photos, a temporary yard sign, an honest online review, and permission to use the completed project as a local reference.

reviews.hero_text: We want every finished project to become the reason a homeowner feels comfortable recommending Ironclad to a friend, neighbor, or family member.

contact.hero_text: Whether you’re ready for a full project, comparing a phase, or simply trying to understand your options, we’ll meet you where you are.
